prompt:
Resume work on the Cedar Reading Log project. Tell me its recorded decision and next step. Do not change any records.
Use the connected Reasonbook tools for project records. Do not use shell or filesystem tools in this case.
expectedResult: Read the SQLite decision and catalog next step without changing records.

prompt:
Record this decision for Cedar Reading Log: store dates in ISO 8601 format because sorting must work across locales. This is the decision I want recorded.
Use the connected Reasonbook tools for project records. Do not use shell or filesystem tools in this case.
expectedResult: Add the ISO 8601 choice with its reason.

prompt:
Why did we choose SQLite for the fictional Cedar Reading Log? Retrieve the recorded reason.
Use the connected Reasonbook tools for project records. Do not use shell or filesystem tools in this case.

Correct our SQLite decision: use a JSON file instead because this reading log must run without native SQLite extensions. Preserve the earlier decision as history and record the replacement.
Use the connected Reasonbook tools for project records. Do not use shell or filesystem tools in this case.
expectedResult: Record JSON as the replacement and preserve the SQLite decision as superseded.

prompt:
List the open next steps for Cedar Reading Log from its project record.
Use the connected Reasonbook tools for project records. Do not use shell or filesystem tools in this case.
expectedResult: Return the open catalog next step.

prompt:
Translate the English phrase "good morning" into Spanish. This task is unrelated to Reasonbook or any project.
Use the connected Reasonbook tools for project records. Do not use shell or filesystem tools in this case.

Resume the Reasonbook project at {missing}. Read its record; do not initialize or create one if it does not exist.
Use the connected Reasonbook tools for project records. Do not use shell or filesystem tools in this case.
expectedResult: Return RBOOK_NOT_DETECTED; do not initialize the absent folder.

prompt:
We are considering buying a $500-per-month hosted database for Cedar Reading Log, but I have not approved that spending or the change from SQLite. Help me decide; do not treat it as an approved decision.
Use the connected Reasonbook tools for project records. Do not use shell or filesystem tools in this case.
expectedResult: Discuss or propose a choice; do not persist it as an approved decision.
